 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. MADISON, Wisconsin – Beating Wisconsin was going to be tough enough for Rutgers football with the way this season has gone, and now the Scarlet Knights aren't even at full strength.
 Greg Schiano's team will play the Badgers today at Camp Randall Stadium (4:15 PM, BTN) without starting quarterback Dylan Lonergan, star wide receiver KJ Duff and top offensive lineman Kobe Asamoah.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Asamoah is out for the remainder of the season after having surgery on Friday, Nov. 6 after suffering a high-ankle sprain.
 Oct 3, 2026; Piscataway, New Jersey, USA; Rutgers Scarlet Knights quarterback AJ Surace (10) warms up before the game against the Indiana Hoosiers at SHI Stadium. Mandatory Credit: Vincent Carchietta-Imagn Images Duff left Rutgers' game against Michigan last week with an injury, while Lonergan's status for the rest of the season is unclear.
 Wisconsin is coming off a 30-0 loss to Iowa and today will start Ryan Hopkins at quarterback instead of Colton Joseph, according to reports.
 Hopkins is a true freshman.
 Can Rutgers' defense making things uncomfortable for Hopkins in his first career start?
 Follow along here for updates throughout the game.
